breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the incorrect instruction to replace the distributed load with its single resultant at midspan for deflection calculation. This is exactly the inconsistency identified, and it does not match the ground truth, which omits that replacement and uses standard superposition cases directly.
